The '''CornerTech Maneuvering Thruster''' was a maneuvering [[Engine/Legends|thruster]] produced by [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Its purpose was to increase the maneuverability of small vessels.
